children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Route selected server and backup events to Discord, Slack, ntfy, email, or webhooks and prove delivery safely.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: A sink in Needs secret state is configured but not operational and must never be treated as an active alert route.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Choose provider and stable audience name, then store its credential in a labelled Secret.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Supported types include Discord, Slack, ntfy, email, and webhook.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Keep credentials out of URLs, descriptions, Git, screenshots, and exports.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Grant only the event and provider scope required.

children.name: Section Body Language
children.text: Each sink can have its own language. Its messages and test sends use it; sinks without one use the instance default, which falls back to English.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Discord, email and webhook messages follow the sink's language.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Unsupported language tags are rejected with 400.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Kubernetes reason and message stay in English.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Subscribe to actionable failure and recovery events, then send a test through the real delivery path.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Use server unhealthy/recovered and backup/restore outcomes intentionally.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Confirm the test arrives with useful cluster/server context.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Repair Needs secret before relying on delivery.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Inspect dispatch results, endpoint health, authentication, quota, and permissions; rotate and retest credentials.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Provider + stable name + credential-backed labelled Secret

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Choose actionable events + Send test; Needs secret = broken
